correctness.rationale: Every infinite-index assertion reduces to a polynomial identity whose difference is strictly increasing for all relevant indices. Exact mass normalization and count-survival formula match the original family; the first log-curvature determinant is 4L and the first hazard numerator is a positive multiple of H. Positive quadratic roots yield the complete parameter classification including equality; F(n) increasing proves a unique trough if H<0. SymPy checker recomputes these identities and exact rational witnesses.

value.rationale: The exact two-threshold phase diagram classifies strong unimodality and IFR for an applied mixed-Poisson count family and identifies a genuine change from monotone to bathtub-shaped discrete failure hazard. The nonempty IFR-but-not-logconcave region and explicit trough index separate two natural reliability notions, going substantially beyond mere moment computation or a fixed-parameter example.
